title: Nabiyyi xaqut tan xongoloola
intro: alla baaxol, massakaxxale farmoyti woo dabaanih miraaciini caylak gibdi cinna kaak garaye. Uxih qunxa maroyta diggale roocitte Yallih taamaynah xaqut soolan, qibaadah seeco gacsaanam faxan. ken aggiriqqe sinni kibal caylale agat kurruumam kee ellecaboh kufri caylittel aysele.
clues: Nanu qunxa buttak sugne, imaan kee hadafal inkittinaane luk sugne.
Nanu ken baaxok caylale reedoonul cinneh yan massakaxxale farmoytih xaqut soolenno.
Tama farmoyti yoo essere way Yallih gital yoo qokola mara iyyaay? nanu qammaxxaaga sinnim gacisneh.
Nanu tama farmoyti esserreh qaraanak qiid gorrisuh ni sorkocobaxih asmat bahtuh.
Woo dabaanih marih fanak inki inki mari ni farmot yeemeneeh gersi mari kaadu giddilitak cineh immay Yalli muumini mara diggooseh.
Nanu Hawwariyyun — Isaak diggalsimeh yan adabi, Yallih qokolut mayso geyne.

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ كُونُوٓا۟ أَنصَارَ ٱللَّهِ كَمَا قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ لِلْحَوَارِيِّـۧنَ مَنْ أَنصَارِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ قَالَ ٱلْحَوَارِيُّونَ نَحْنُ أَنصَارُ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَـَٔامَنَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنۢ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَكَفَرَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ ۖ فَأَيَّدْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ عَلَىٰ عَدُوِّهِمْ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ ظَـٰهِرِينَ
verse: O you who have believed, be supporters of Allāh, as when Jesus, the son of Mary, said to the disciples, "Who are my supporters for Allāh?" The disciples said, "We are supporters of Allāh." And a faction of the Children of Israel believed and a faction disbelieved. So We supported those who believed against their enemy, and they became dominant. (61:14)
